choose.when: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM business_application a WHERE a.target_person_id=p.person_id AND a.applicant_user_id=#{scope.userId})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM business_application a WHERE a.target_person_id=p.person_id AND a.applicant_department_id=#{scope.departmentId})

choose.otherwise: AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM residence rs WHERE rs.person_id=p.person_id AND rs.status='ACTIVE' AND rs.region_code IN #{regionCodeItem}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM business_application a WHERE a.target_person_id=p.person_id AND a.applicant_region_code IN #{regionCodeItem}))

choose.when: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM business_application a WHERE a.target_household_id=h.household_id AND a.applicant_department_id=#{scope.departmentId})

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) FROM person p LEFT JOIN residence r ON r.person_id=p.person_id AND r.status='ACTIVE' WHERE p.current_status_code='REGISTERED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM residence active_residence WHERE active_residence.person_id=p.person_id AND active_residence.status='ACTIVE')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM floating_population f JOIN business_application a ON a.application_id=f.source_application_id WHERE f.current_flag=1 AND f.status='ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT k.person_id) FROM key_population k JOIN person p ON p.person_id=k.person_id LEFT JOIN residence r ON r.person_id=p.person_id AND r.status='ACTIVE' WHERE k.status='ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM household h WHERE h.status='ACTIVE'

SELECT k.key_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS `value` FROM key_population k JOIN person p ON p.person_id=k.person_id LEFT JOIN residence r ON r.person_id=p.person_id AND r.status='ACTIVE' WHERE k.status='ACTIVE'
GROUP BY k.key_type ORDER BY k.key_type

SELECT c.status AS name, COUNT(*) AS `value` FROM certificate c JOIN person p ON p.person_id=c.person_id LEFT JOIN residence r ON r.person_id=p.person_id AND r.status='ACTIVE' WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY c.status ORDER BY c.status

SELECT mi.in_date AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM migration_in mi JOIN business_application a ON a.application_id=mi.application_id WHERE mi.business_status='COMPLETED' AND mi.in_date >=#{from} AND mi.in_date <=CURRENT_DATE
GROUP BY mi.in_date ORDER BY mi.in_date

SELECT mo.out_date AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM migration_out mo JOIN business_application a ON a.application_id=mo.application_id WHERE mo.business_status='COMPLETED' AND mo.out_date >=#{from} AND mo.out_date <=CURRENT_DATE
GROUP BY mo.out_date ORDER BY mo.out_date
